mapper.sql: id, control_code, domain, control_name, control_objective, control_description, control_type, automation, frequency, control_owner, dept, is_key_control, is_itdm_control, effectiveness, design_adequacy, last_test_date, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itgc_control ( control_code, domain, control_name, control_objective, control_description, control_type, automation, frequency, control_owner, dept, is_key_control, is_itdm_control, effectiveness, design_adequacy, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{controlCode}, #{domain}, #{controlName}, #{controlObjective}, #{controlDescription}, #{controlType}, #{automation}, #{frequency}, #{controlOwner}, #{dept}, #{isKeyControl}, #{isItdmControl}, #{effectiveness}, #{designAdequacy}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_control SET domain = #{domain}, control_name = #{controlName}, control_objective = #{controlObjective}, control_description = #{controlDescription}, control_type = #{controlType}, automation = #{automation}, frequency = #{frequency}, control_owner = #{controlOwner}, dept = #{dept}, is_key_control = #{isKeyControl}, is_itdm_control = #{isItdmControl}, effectiveness = #{effectiveness}, design_adequacy = #{designAdequacy}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE itgc_control SET design_adequacy = #{designAdequacy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.risk_id, r.risk_code, r.risk_name, m.control_id, c.control_code, c.control_name, m.mapping_type, m.remarks, m.created_at, m.created_by FROM itgc_risk_control_mapping m JOIN itgc_risk r ON r.id = m.risk_id JOIN itgc_control c ON c.id = m.control_id ORDER BY r.risk_code, c.control_code

SELECT domain, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN effectiveness = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective, SUM(CASE WHEN effectiveness = '부분효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial, SUM(CASE WHEN effectiveness = '비효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ineffective, SUM(CASE WHEN is_key_control = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_control_count, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN effectiveness = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1 ) AS effectiveness_rate FROM itgc_control GROUP BY domain ORDER BY domain
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itgc_risk_control_mapping (risk_id, control_id, mapping_type, remarks, created_by) VALUES (#{riskId}, #{controlId}, #{mappingType}, #{remarks}, #{createdBy})
